method: Editorial close reading of all three complete TeX sources, not independent implementation evidence, a novelty count, or a statistical vote.

core.qualification: Ordinary subtype/context translation and written relative preservation; no implemented or verified compiler.

anchor.qualification: Open evidence rows retain the underlying term; scopes, allowed assumptions, and typed context embeddings govern reuse.

structures.qualification: Lexical structure environment is meaning-bearing data selected before property search, not a global instance oracle.

behavior.qualification: Extrinsic consequence, ordered relational premises, whole-function and higher-order laws; total function contracts remain distinct from partial domains.

bounded.qualification: Prefers backward sufficient-demand propagation plus indexed cheap facts; permits a small terminating entailment fragment without a closure-completeness theorem.

observation.qualification: Relations retain original anchors, region and precision; the consumer receives only a proved relation-specific bridge.

leant.qualification: Current callback and Length boundaries credited; proof/data/edit requests separated, original-target proof or adequacy bridge required. Does not derive the List Empty realizability condition.

checker.qualification: Tiny natural affine normalizer has explicit denotation, soundness and definitionally reified original target in uncompiled source; no general source reifier.

fidelity.qualification: Required method versus hint, frozen theorem versus generated guard, and rendered mathematical meaning remain separate obligations.

evaluation.qualification: Five nested arms isolate libraries, services, property inference and narrative syntax; charge infrastructure and stop if matched Lean wins.

core.qualification: Bidirectional property judgment has ordinary Lean translation; written small-calculus result and uncompiled reference encoding only.

anchor.qualification: Same local object with separate evidence; exact ordered dependent guards and checked context maps, no substitution by display identity.

structures.qualification: Object-bound dictionaries and map arguments form a structure footprint; classification follows semantic role, not class/structure syntax.

behavior.qualification: Consequence direction and inter-stage precondition bridge explicit; actual intermediate witness retained; total guarantee distinguished from admissible-input function.

bounded.qualification: Cheap deterministic forward consequences then bounded backward demand search; no principal strongest refinement. A unique weakest registered guard is not guaranteed merely by finiteness.

observation.qualification: Commuting squares, joint faithfulness, and witness realizability separated; finite-prefix example tests all-prefix universal coverage.

leant.qualification: Exact provider laws plus positive/negative abstraction directions; List Empty counterexample forbids unrealizable abstract hard rejection.

fidelity.qualification: Statement meaning frozen; method nodes must actually instantiate advertised theorem; all intermediate authored claims and display guarantees checked independently.

evaluation.qualification: Matched fully equipped Lean, inference-only then surface treatments; separate blinded reading study, development/holdout distinction and library-only stopping outcome.

core.qualification: Small complete core has written translation and restricted coherence argument; no Lean companion or compiled frontend.

anchor.qualification: Proof-only local rows preserve raw term; typed dependencies and context transport required; Python scope prefixes explicitly limited.

structures.qualification: Three semantic roles: operations, laws, witness data; selected dictionaries and routes rechecked across imports.

behavior.qualification: Pre/post variance and witness-retaining composition; analytical relation and region remain visible; recursion/operational obligations separate.

bounded.qualification: Finite grounded rule closure has termination and relative completeness; costs exclude rule generation, instantiation, typechecking and proof size.

observation.qualification: Relation-specific preservation/reflection, exact observation kinds and entailment-based reuse; no universal strength rank.

leant.qualification: Law registry, fixed behavioral predicate, exact edit replay and direct-theorem controls; length is insufficient for permutation, no explicit List Empty derivation.

checker.qualification: Affine nonnegative rational combinations: paper denotation/soundness and exact Python reifier/checker; all three Lean bridges remain implementation work.

fidelity.qualification: Distinguishes statement, typed method application, public-interface premises, supplied premises and retained proof dependencies.

evaluation.qualification: Nested library/inference/synthesis/syntax treatments plus ablation, maintenance, import sensitivity and tail latency; keep only empirically useful layers.
